comments.body:
Jared Whiklo, here is a patch for allowing "-Paudit" to build:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/compare/master...awoods:fcrepo-2028

Thanks Andrew Woods, I did finally get that part. I am having trouble included those tests with this profile.

My attempt is here:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/compare/master...whikloj:FCREPO-2028?expand=1

I'm think I probably need to leave the tests in place but exclude them by default and include them in the connector-file profile.

Related PRs:
Remove fcrepo-connector-file from core codebase:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1056

Andrew Woods,

I found that if I use

<systemProperty>
   <name>fcrepo.modeshape.configuration</name>
   <value>${fcrepo.modeshape.configuration}</value>
</systemProperty>

within the jetty-maven-plugin configuration (with the property defined in the pom.xml) it doesn't set it. Instead I see something like

[DEBUG]   (s) systemProperty = org.eclipse.jetty.maven.plugin.SystemProperty@4a2891d1
[DEBUG]   (s) name = fcrepo.modeshape.configuration
[DEBUG]   (s) systemProperty = org.eclipse.jetty.maven.plugin.SystemProperty@7b6d88d1

So if I change it to

<systemProperty>
   <name>fcrepo.modeshape.configuration</name>
   <value>${project.basedir}/src/test/resources/config/test_repository.json</value>
</systemProperty>

I see it gets set properly:

[DEBUG]   (s) systemProperty = org.eclipse.jetty.maven.plugin.SystemProperty@4a2891d1
[DEBUG]   (s) name = fcrepo.modeshape.configuration
[DEBUG]   (s) value = /sw/var/www/fcrepo4/fcrepo-webapp-plus/src/test/resources/config/test_repository.json
[DEBUG]   (s) systemProperty = org.eclipse.jetty.maven.plugin.SystemProperty@7b6d88d1

But then it tells me the file doesn't exist, even though it does.

I also tried

<systemProperty>
   <name>fcrepo.modeshape.configuration</name>
   <value>classpath:/config/test_repository.json</value>
</systemProperty>

It also cannot locate the file.

Maybe this is due to
contextPath = /
but I'm not sure what it should be?

Hints, or suggestions appreciated. I hate leaning on you for maven stuff, but I really don't get it.

Without seeing the details of your server log it is a bit tricky to say definitively, but have you tried:

<systemProperty>
   <name>fcrepo.modeshape.configuration</name>
   <value>classpath:${project.basedir}/src/test/resources/config/test_repository.json</value>
</systemProperty>

Yeah, sorry.

I'm bowing out, I don't want my lack of Maven skills to delay the 4.6 release.

My work up to now is all here https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo-webapp-plus/tree/FCREPO-2028, for what it is worth...

A. Soroka: For the requested warning, would something like
FedoraFileSystemConnector will be removed from the core of Fedora and packaged in fcrepo-webapp-plus in the next release.
be adequate and correct?
I think so. Andrew Woods?

That text looks good... if we are committing to this work being in the next release. I did not hear any volunteers for that task on today's call. Therefore, I would change the text to something like "Warning: FedoraFileSystemConnector ... in a coming release".

I was more concerned that it was going to hold up a release, but if there is no deadline for my buffonery I'll continue trying to get it working.

But based on the "...my buffonery..." part of my previous statement, I will vacillate in the message.

Jared Whiklo, This needs some clean-up (particularly `AbstractResourceIT`), but it should be enough to get you going again.
https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/3

Let me know if you need any help.
